prompt: What is the name of the fastest supercomputer in the world that runs on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and is hosted outside the United States?
answer: The fastest RHEL-based supercomputer hosted outside the United States is **JUPITER Booster**, located at the **Jülich Supercomputing Centre in Germany**.
